Hand a client a report, not a screenshot

Every Eagle Eye scan exports as a report a client can read on their own — the geo-grid map, the three numbers, and the competitor picture — carrying your logo, your colours and your footer, not ours.

What you can export

  • Branded PDF — the map and the numbers, ready to send or present.
  • CSV — the scan’s listings and points, for your own spreadsheets and dashboards.
  • Time-lapse GIF — every run of a scan as a short film, so progress is obvious at a glance.

White-label reporting is why agencies run Eagle Eye — see the agency workflow. Prefer to pull the raw data into your own tools? Use the API. See the plans.

Three numbers, every scan

The whole grid rolls up into the figures a client actually remembers — tracked every run so the trend is the proof.

LSOVLocal Share of Voice

How much of the whole grid finds the business near the top — one number for the entire map.

ARPAverage Rank, found

The mean position across only the points that return the business at all.

ATRPAverage Total Rank

The same average, counting every point that missed the business entirely — the honest one.

Questions, answered

Can I white-label Eagle Eye reports?

Yes — every scan exports with your own logo, colours and footer, not ours: the geo-grid map, the three numbers and the competitor picture.

What can I export?

A branded PDF of the map and numbers, a CSV of the scan’s listings and points, and a time-lapse GIF of every run of a scan.

Why do agencies use branded reports?

They hand a client a report they can read on their own, carrying the agency’s brand — not a screenshot, and not Eagle Eye’s name.

Can I pull the raw data into my own tools instead?

Yes — the API lets you read the scan data straight into your own dashboards and portals.

What does it cost?

Every plan is a bucket of credits and a scan spends one credit per grid point: 81 credits for a 9 × 9 scan, up to 441 for a 21 × 21. Points you switch off or leave outside your shape cost nothing, and credits you buy never expire.

Find out where you really rank

Your first scan of your own site is free, at any grid size. No card needed.
